quotes.t: Don't follow your passion, follow your talent.
Greatness is in the agency of others.
There's no such thing as balance, only trade-offs. You can have it all, just not at the same time.
Expect that a certain amount of failure is out of your control, and recognize you may need to endure it or move on.
The brick walls are there for a reason. They let us prove how badly we want something.
We cannot change the cards we are dealt, just how we play the hand.
Experience is what you get when you didn't get what you wanted.
It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
We keep moving forward, opening new doors, and doing new things, because we're curious.
All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
Mars is there, waiting to be reached.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
You can't connect the dots looking forward. You can only connect them looking backwards.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
Be less curious about people and more curious about ideas.
One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
Ship it, then polish it.
One thing at a time. This one.
Done beats perfect.
Make it obvious.
Small steps, every day.
Future you says thanks.
Bet on yourself.
Be the calm in the room.
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
A man is but the product of his thoughts. What he thinks, he becomes.
It has always been easier to destroy than to create.
Truth never damages a cause that is just.
Earth provides enough to satisfy every man's need but not for every man's greed.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
The important thing is not to stop questioning.
I have no special talents. I am only passionately curious.
Try not to become a man of success, but a man of value.
I never think of the future. It comes soon enough.
Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love.
Health is the greatest gift, contentment the greatest wealth.
Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
Drop by drop is the water pot filled.
What we think, we become.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
True simplicity is derived from so much more than just the absence of clutter and ornamentation.
I think a beautiful product that doesn't work very well is ugly.
The memory of how we work will endure beyond the products of our work.
The delight and joy of curiosity and learning can temper our fear of doing something completely new.
Very often design is the most immediate way of defining what products become in people's minds.
The defining qualities are about use: ease and simplicity.
It takes a lot of money to look this cheap.
The way I look was really a country girl's idea of what glamour was.
Find out who you are and do it on purpose.
Don't get so busy making a living that you forget to make a life.
Born a wildlife warrior, die a wildlife warrior.
Crikey means gee whiz, wow!
We're all trying to do the same thing. Live well.
You're only given a little spark of madness and if you lose that, you're nothin'.
In this industry, interest in you comes in waves, it's so tidal.
I do a lot of my best thinking in those kind of in-between moments.
Clear beats clever.
Start before you're ready.
Make the next step small.
Finish one thing today.
Kind, clear, and quick.
Build what you wish existed.
Ask. The worst answer is no.
Progress, not perfection.
Rest is part of the work.
Say it plainly.
Momentum loves a deadline.
Protect the morning.
Ship small, ship often.
Good enough, then better.
You've done hard things before.
Breathe. Then decide.
Talk to one customer today.
Leave it better than you found it.
Curious beats certain.
Make it easy to say yes.
